latest_news.headline: IRGC warns: will widen strikes on Israeli troops in Lebanon/Gaza if civilian death toll rises
latest_news.text: IRGC issues new threat: will expand strikes on Israeli military positions across Lebanon and Gaza if civilian casualties continue mounting. Geographic expansion of threat beyond Gulf/Israel to occupied territories.

latest_news.headline: Iran publicly denies all dialogue with US despite Trump's 'productive talks' claims
latest_news.text: Iran continues to flatly deny any diplomatic contact with Washington. Trump claims 'very strong talks' via Witkoff channel. Iranian officials call it 'fakenews.' Gap between US claims and Iranian denial widening.

latest_news.headline: Iran threatens 'complete closure' of Hormuz if US strikes power plants
latest_news.text: Iran warns Strait of Hormuz will be 'completely closed' if US proceeds with threatened strikes on Iranian power plants. Escalation of energy weaponization threats.

latest_news.headline: IDF issues new evacuation warning for Burj Shemali, southern Lebanon

latest_news.headline: Hezbollah claims 50+ attacks on Israeli border positions
latest_news.text: Hezbollah announces more than 50 attacks targeting Israeli troops and bases in northern Israel and southern Lebanon, particularly in Naqura. Sustained resistance despite ground losses.

latest_news.text: China's top diplomat called Iranian counterpart, urged dialogue. 'Talking is always better than to keep fighting.' China active diplomatic push for Iran ceasefire.

latest_news.headline: UN Human Rights Council to hold urgent meeting on Iran's Gulf strikes
latest_news.text: UN Human Rights Council announces urgent meeting on Wednesday regarding Iran's strikes on Gulf countries. International pressure mounting on both sides.
